description: Election Commission - Declare that Mrs. A. R. N. Aluthgamage of the Ganga Ihala Korale Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of member - Declare that Mr. M. P. Wigneswaran of the Kandy Municipal Council has vacated his office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabha and Municipal Council) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and changes in candidate status.
